source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 338 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 338 was established by Ordinance No. 20791, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 14, 1990. Ordinance No. 20791 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 338 is established on property generally fronting on the northeast line of C.F. Hawn Freeway (U.S. Highway 175), southeast of the east line of Cade Road. The size of PD 338 is approximately 5.4881 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to code articles, divisions, and sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, and sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the site/landscape plan (Exhibit 338A). (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.105. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the site/landscape plan. All landscaping must be installed within six months of November 14, 1990. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.106. USES.

An outside salvage or reclamation use is permitted by right on the Property. The only additional uses permitted on the Property are those uses allowed in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking and loading for each use must be provided in accordance with the requirements of Division 51A-4.300. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.108. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

All development standards must comply with the yard, lot, and space regulations for the IM Industrial Manufacturing District as provided in Section 51A-4.123(d)(4). (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.109. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Fences
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.110. FENCES.

Fences must be provided in accordance with the site/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.111. ACCESS.

No access is allowed between the Property and Rylie Crest Road, Stinson Street, or Calamar Street. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.112. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-338.113. ZONING MAP.

PD 338 is located on Zoning Map No. N-11. (Ord. Nos. 20791; 25850)
